title: Check whether anything was pending with USCIS
plain_summary: If they had an application or petition pending with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, a relative may be able to continue it. An immigration attorney can tell you what applies.
attorney_referral_note: Cairn can't give legal advice. An immigration attorney can tell you what applies.

citations.authority_name: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, Policy Manual, Volume 7, Part A, Chapter 9
